cd /root/reimbursement-assistant && python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, pathlib
files = {"server.mjs":"","app.js":"","styles.css":"","package.json":"","package-lock.json":""}
for name, data in files.items():
    pathlib.Path(name).write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data))
    print('wrote', name)
PY
npm install --omit=dev
pm2 restart reimbursement-assistant
pm2 status reimbursement-assistant
